As summer deals continue on AirPods Pro 3 down $50, AirPods Max 2 down $100, and Apple AirTag 2 falling to $22 each, today's headliners at the 9to5Toys Lunchtime Deals include this 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro at $320 off, alongside ongoing $500 off on the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, alongside the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air configuration with the upgraded power adapter at $170 off. We also have official Apple USB-C cables from $7.50 each, the black Apple iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case down a massive 32% (Amazon all-time low), and more waiting for you below.

This 24GB 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro is $320 off today, 2TB M5 Pro now $500 off at Amazon

The best MacBook deals right now are pretty much a no-brainer – Amazon is currently selling the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off new MSRP. For those looking to pick up the M5 MacBook Air, we have $200 off the 24GB configuration, and we also spotted this more affordable Pro variant – the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro – for $320 in savings.

B&H is currently selling the most affordable new 24GB MacBook Pro available right now for $1,899 (with free shipping) – the model with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage.

This machine also includes an upgraded official 96W power adapter, which would cost you an extra $20 if you configured your purchase on Apple's website.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $1,899 (originally $2,219)
  • Includes upgraded 96W Apple power adapter ($20 value)

All told, you're saving $320 off the original $2,219 price tag, the best deal we've found on this machine from a reputable retailer. As a side note, Amazon has the same model with the standard 70W charger listed at $2,049.

Here's a roundup of the best MacBook Pro deals this week:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,299 (originally $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,499 (originally $2,999) – $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $2,699 (originally $3,099)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

Score $500 off M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB, $400 off 48GB models, and more

The most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with upgraded power adapter is $170 off today

While we're still tracking the $200 off deal on the 24GB M5 MacBook Pro, we spotted an even more attractive deal this morning on the entry-level 15-inch model – $150 less than that, or $170 off MSRP.

As we reported in detail yesterday, Amazon is currently taking $100 off nearly every M5 MacBook Air configuration it sells:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,199 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,499 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,399 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,699 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,899 (originally $1,999)

That said, B&H also has notable markdowns this week, including the aforementioned 24GB model down to $1,499, alongside this $170 price drop on the entry-level 15-inch M5 MacBook Air setup:

B&H is now selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage for $1,349 (with free shipping).

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,349 (originally $1,519)
  • Includes upgraded 70W Apple power adapter ($20 value)

That's $150 off MSRP, $50 below Amazon, and B&H's discounted model also includes the upgraded 70W Apple power adapter. Configuring the same machine directly from Apple with that charger would cost $1,519 – so you're effectively saving $170.

Already discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables get an extra 10% off today, from $7.50 each

Apple's black iPhone 17 Pro Max TechWoven MagSafe case is down 32% (Amazon all-time low)

Amazon has brought back the all-time low prices on the newest 2026 Apple AirTag 4-pack during 'Black Friday in July' week, and since multiple official offers are scheduled to end tonight, today might be your last chance – Amazon has added a countdown timer to the deal showing the deals disappearing at midnight.

Apple Watch Series 11 summer deals starting to disappear, grab the most popular model while it's still $100 off

While we're still tracking the summer deals on AirPods Pro 3 down $50, AirPods Max 2 down $100, and the all-time low price on the Apple AirTag 2 4-pack, the deals on the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 are starting to disappear. If you're interested in upgrading your Apple wearable for $100 off, you'll want to act fast.

Amazon is currently selling the 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 for $299 and the 46mm version for $329 (with free shipping). That's $100 off the original prices of $399 and $429 respectively, the lowest available for these models anywhere.

That said, color options are starting to disappear for these deals. Some colors are still available at the sale price, but it appears Series 11 summer discounts are starting to sell out or revert to full price as of this week.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As mentioned above, these $100 price drops, alongside a range of other ongoing notable deals, span the latest AirPods, iPhone 17 Pro, and especially attractive $500 discounts on the M5 Pro MacBook Pro lineup:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)

If you're looking to score the latest iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount this week, you have options. Deals on brand-new unlocked models are hard to come by from reputable retailers, but we're still tracking up to $220 off Amazon's highest-quality refurbished 17 Pro models, and Woot is once again featuring up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max.

Over at Amazon, the 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models are once again available for up to $220 off – these are Amazon Renewed Premium units that come with a 1-year Amazon Renewed warranty and a guarantee of 'greater than 90% of original battery life.' Standard Amazon Renewed units only come with a 90-day warranty and don't carry the same battery guarantee.
